request.description: Any UAE mobile format works: 0501234567, 971501234567, +971 50 123 4567. When nothing matches the registered mobile, every other phone number Keyloop holds for the customer (Phone1-3, landlines, foreign numbers) is tried digit-for-digit - the spec's "search by another phone number" for a caller on an unregistered line. Add `group=BMW` to restrict to one dealer group; `limit` defaults to 20 (max 100).
